import sys, json, random, time, ctypes, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/dev')
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
from netnomos.finite import compile_job
from gen import rand_predicate
from brute import bf_compile_job

rng = random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]))
best = 0
for trial in range(int(sys.argv[2])):
    nfields = rng.randint(2,4); slots = rng.randint(1,3)
    if nfields*slots > 16: continue
    fields=[{'name':f'f{i}','type':rng.choice(['count','id','flag','size','time']),
             'domain': rng.choice([[0,1],[0,1,2],[0,1,2,3]])} for i in range(nfields)]
    preds=[rand_predicate(rng, fields, slots) for _ in range(32)]
    cell_doms=[f['domain'] for _ in range(slots) for f in fields]
    total=1
    for d in cell_doms: total*=len(d)
    if total > 512: continue
    universe=list(itertools.product(*cell_doms))
    ntrain=rng.randint(20,60)
    train=[]
    for _ in range(ntrain):
        w=rng.choice(universe)
        train.append([list(w[s*nfields:(s+1)*nfields]) for s in range(slots)])
    job={'fields':fields,'slots':slots,'predicates':preds,'width':4,'train':train,
         'approved':[sorted(rng.sample(range(32), rng.randint(1,4))) for _ in range(8)],
         'queries':[]}
    t0=time.time(); out=compile_job(job); el=time.time()-t0
    if len(out['rules'])>best:
        best=len(out['rules'])
        print(f'trial={trial} universe={total} train={ntrain} rules={best} time={el:.2f}s')
        if best > 300:
            b=bf_compile_job(job)
            print('   brute agrees:', b==out)
print('best rules:', best)
EOF
